name: Can You Widen a Driveway in Los Angeles County?

mainEntity.name: Can a driveway contractor widen my driveway in Los Angeles County without affecting setbacks or the sidewalk?
mainEntity.text: Can a driveway contractor widen my driveway in Los Angeles County without affecting setbacks or the sidewalk?

acceptedAnswer.text: Driveway widening is possible on many properties, but it is not automatic. The available width depends on setbacks, property lines, utilities, landscaping, easements, and how much of the front yard can legally be converted to hardscape. If the work reaches the sidewalk, curb, parkway, or gutter area, the project may need extra approvals and inspections. A knowledgeable contractor should review the site plan, measure the usable area, and identify any constraints before designing the new layout. Homeowners should also ask about drainage, because a wider driveway can change runoff patterns and create water problems if the slope is not handled correctly. In dense parts of Los Angeles County, access and parking geometry can also influence the final design. The safest approach is to have the contractor confirm the expansion limits first, then build the design around the allowed footprint rather than assuming the entire front yard can be paved.
